from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-52f19358.py'
source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = min((color for color in counts if color != background), key=counts.get)

    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    top = min(r for r, _ in points)
    bottom = max(r for r, _ in points)
    left = min(c for _, c in points)
    right = max(c for _, c in points)
    mask = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points]
    height, width = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(len(grid) - height + 1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in mask):
                for dr, dc in mask:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
'''
